description: the plate [0, 10] × [0, 6] × [0, 2] with a U slot 2 wide cut in from x = 10, its round end the half cylinder of radius 1 about (5, 3) converted to its exact rational B-spline and sewn back, written by tools/oracle/occt_nurbs_blend.py: the slot's top rim filleted at r 0.25 from its line on y = 2. The chain runs on at two tangent vertices, (5, 2, 2) and (5, 4, 2), through the half circle on the NURBS face into the line on y = 4: a table stripe, a walked stripe (ADR-0062) and a table stripe, meeting on the ball's arcs in the planes x = 5 (ADR-0035 §3), each line's far end cut by the plate's face x = 10 (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 5b). Arris' blend holds the ball at r from both faces to 3e-9 at the median of 451 samples; Open CASCADE's misses it by 2.5e-7 at the median and 6.5e-7 at the 90th percentile, so its measures lie 2.3e-9 relative from Arris' STEP read back, and agree with it to 4e-11 when it is asked to approximate to 1e-8. The measure tolerances cover that miss (ADR-0062, a walked fixture)
